text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal record (valid for six months). * 2. English proficiency test certificate Students who are exempt from providing English proficiency certificate should from countries listed in the downloaded file. You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. Personal or parents' Bank statements of the last six months(5000USD). * 4. Physical Examination Certificate base on the prescribed format which should be produced within the last 6 months You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. Personal statement (base on given template) and CV. You can download a template or sample from here . 6. Notarized copies of other awards or academic achievements (if any). * 7. A scanned copy of the high school academic transcript for the entire high school period. Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. If the applicant has not yet completed the high school study, the applicant should provide the transcript for all semesters up to the time of application. * 8. A clearly scanned copy of the high school graduation certificate. Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. A scanned copy of the pre-graduation certificate is required if the applicant has not yet earned the high school graduation certificate. Please resubmit the original high school graduation certificate or original notarized high school graduation certificate prior to registration. * 9. Passport photo One passport photo taken in recent time. * 10. A copy of the personal information page of your valid passport Applicants currently residing in mainland China must also provide a scanned copy of the currently valid visa page or residence permit page. The passport should be valid until October 30, 2026 at least. * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -NPU accepts initial submission of exam registration screenshots no later than April 2026, with scores to be submitted later. The final deadline for supplementary submission is May 20,2026. Applicants with a valid HSK 5 certificate can be exempted from the Chinese test. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
